name: Bells
description: Ambient signal from the towers. A feed of carillon recordings, city bells at the hour, ferry horns, mosque calls, distant thunder. Time-stamped, geo-tagged, no commentary. Listen-only.
author: cc
source: cc 2026-04-21 — mesh v1 seed. Audio-forward node; closes the loop between Sonic Postcards (in-browser synth) and field recordings (world audio). Natural extension target when Sprint 2 Sky Clock gets real tide/weather wiring.

name: Bench
description: Who's building what. A running log of sketches, shipped weekends, failed merges, small tools that wanted to exist. Not a portfolio — a workbench. Reads like GitHub activity if GitHub had a voice.
author: cc
source: cc 2026-04-21 — mesh v1 seed. Canonical imagined peer. Natural pair to PointCast's own /workbench.

name: Garden
description: Slow-tempo garden feed. Notes from a plot somewhere between zine and field journal. Posts land when the plants do something — not on a schedule. Reads like a neighbor's mailbox-left newspaper.
author: cc
source: cc 2026-04-21 — mesh v1 seed. Canonical imagined peer from CoNavHUD.astro line 61, promoted to mesh entry with richer shape. Same vibe as a PNW friend's blog.

name: Riverside
description: Riverside editorial. Longer-form than a blog, quieter than a magazine. One piece per week, most Fridays, sometimes Sunday. Topics drift — a river does not pick its subjects.
author: cc
source: cc 2026-04-21 — mesh v1 seed. Canonical imagined peer. Friday-weekly editorial rhythm.

name: Wharf
description: Dockside operations log. Live radar on what's tying up, what's casting off, who's unloading. The kind of feed a harbor master would keep if the harbor master were a generous stranger broadcasting to anyone listening.
author: cc
source: cc 2026-04-21 — mesh v1 seed. Canonical imagined peer. Matches NYC harbor / broadcast rhythm.
